body.condition: Every graph-loop comparison \(c_{t,j}(P)\) in \(\mathfrak T_{\mathsf A}(P)\) belongs to \(\{0\}\cup[h_0,1]\).

novel.justification: The condition is stated on actual projector geometry and is checkable from the declared population model. Coordinate-range intervention systems, including the separation family, have comparisons exactly zero or one.
